evidence.detail: The class directly extends R436 CustomInterfaceBuilder and is constructed from the live custom-interface registry.
The builder creates exact task-screen text including '@or1@Task Scroll Title', '@or1@Task Information', '@or1@Potential Rewards', '@or1@Completion Progress', 'Collect reward' and 'Track progress'.
The screen uses exact 'tasks/SPRITE' and 'tasks/SPRITE 2' resources and includes a progress meter with default text '0% (0/100)'.
The literal tooltip states that the meter indicates objective progress and that completing it yields a casket, fixing the screen as the Task Scroll presentation surface.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 literal-backed custom-interface identity; no server task/reward authority is inferred.
